/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L9: Speakers: Calvin, Dave
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin, long time no see! A lot's been happening since we last talked. Guess what? I finally opened my own car maintenance shop! It's so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars - it's like a dream come true! Take a look at the photo.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L16: Calvin: Wow Dave! Congrats on opening your own car maintenance shop! It looks like all your hard work and dedication paid off.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L23: Calvin: Woo, Dave! Congrats on achieving your dream - you've got guts and ambition - that's awesome! Keep it up!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, Dave! Going for it with classic cars is cool! Fulfilling your dreams is so important.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L38: Calvin: Wow, Dave! That looks awesome!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L41: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It was a labor of love. Challenging, but so worth it.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L44: Calvin: Yeah, it's awesome when you see something you worked on come to life.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L50: Calvin: Yeah, it's an amazing feeling when you create something and it resonates with people. It's so satisfying when you finish something you made from scratch!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L53: Dave: Yeah, Calvin! It's such an amazing feeling to see something you create become a reality. Knowing that your skills and hard work made it happen is incredible.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L56: Calvin: Yeah, Dave! Feels good when our hard work pays off. It's the perfect blend of dedication and passion!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L62: Calvin: Keep going for it!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L69: Calvin: Wow, your shop looks great! I'd love to check it out sometime. What sort of cars do you work on at your shop?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L72: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I work on all kinds of cars at the shop - from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars. It keeps me busy and happy!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L75: Calvin: Wow Dave, working on cars must be really rewarding.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L81: Calvin: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Doing something you love and helping others is so rewarding. Keep up the great work!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L87: Calvin: Glad to help, Dave! So awesome to see you doing your thing and making a difference. Your hard work and talent totally deserve all the recognition. Keep on keepin' on, bud! Take a look at this beautiful necklace with a diamond pendant, that's so stunning!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L94: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I got it from another artist as a gift - it's a great reminder of why I keep hustling as a musician!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L97: Dave: Awesome, Calvin! Keep pushing and making music, it'll remind us why we keep hustling.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L100: Calvin: Yeah, Dave! The road can be hard, but when we remember why we're doing it, it keeps us going. Let's keep each other motivated!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L3: description: Session 5 on 2023-05-03 between Calvin and Dave.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L9: Speakers: Calvin, Dave
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin! Long time no talk. How's it going? Crazy news - I'm teaming up with a local garage. Take a look at what we working on together!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L16: Calvin: Hey Dave, great to hear from you! That's awesome news about teaming up with a local garage. Super inspiring seeing you follow your passion. Congratulations on this new venture. It's impressive how far you've come since we last chatted. How's everything going?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L20: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I'm loving this job. I get to work with awesome mechanics and share my knowledge about cars. Here's what I'm currently working on! It's a cool project, even if it's a bit challenging. 🤩
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L24: Calvin: That car looks awesome! You're putting in a lot of effort and it's great to see the end result. Keep up the good work. Got any plans for what's next?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L27: Dave: Thanks Calvin! Appreciate the support. I'm gonna keep learning more about auto engineering, maybe even build a custom car from scratch someday - that's the dream! For now, just gonna keep working on this project and assisting customers.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, Dave! You're so inspiring - good for you for pushing yourself to achieve your dream. Making a custom car sounds awesome. Don't forget to relax and enjoy the process too!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L33: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Gotta take time to chill. Do you have any hobbies that help you relax?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L36: Calvin: Hey Dave, long drives in [this car] really help me relax. The feeling of the wind and the open road is so freeing. It helps me clear my head. What do you like to do to chill out? 
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L43: Calvin: Yea, I totally hear ya. Embracing nature has been really calming for me too. I've been loving getting to know Japanese culture. On the other hand, I'm stuck with my music at the moment, like my creativity's frozen or something. Any tips?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L49: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Taking a break is great for getting my mojo back. I'll definitely take your advice and explore. Appreciate the help! You're awesome!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L52: Dave: No worries, Calvin! Glad I could help. Keep pursuing your music and never give up. You're awesome! 🤘
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L55: Calvin: Thanks, appreciate it. Won't give up. Let's stay in touch! Bye!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L58: Dave: Sure, Calvin! Keep in touch. If you ever need help, just let me know. Bye!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L3: description: Session 9 on 2023-06-21 between Calvin and Dave.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L9: Speakers: Calvin, Dave
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L12: Calvin: Hi Dave! Nice to hear from you. Since last chat, some things have happened. I had a lil car accident last Friday, kinda upsetting but no one was hurt. I've been dealing with insurance and repairs - taking up a lot of time and energy. Look at this photo!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L16: Dave: Sorry to hear about the car accident, Calvin. I'm glad to hear that nobody was hurt. Dealing with insurance and repairs can definitely be time-consuming and draining. Have you encountered any issues in the insurance process so far?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L19: Calvin: Hey Dave, thanks for checking in! The insurance process was a hassle - it took forever and there was a ton of paperwork. But it's all sorted now, and I'm getting it fixed up. Can't wait to drive it again!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L26: Calvin: It only took a week to sort everything out. I was worried about the cost, but it wasn't too bad. Look at this photo from the auto repair shop. 
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L33: Calvin: That's the mechanic. He knows the stuff and is doing his best to get my car running again.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L39: Calvin: Feeling way more confident and excited to show off my car! Trusting their expertise.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L45: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Excited to drive again. Appreciate your help! Look what a wonderful view from living room!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L52: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It's from a small town in Japan. The view of the mountains is unbelievably stunning!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L58: Calvin: Nope, not yet! I haven't been there before, but it's on my to-do list for after my tour with Frank Ocean ends. Can't wait to see them in person! Look at that snowy peak.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L65: Calvin: Haven't tried it before, but it does look like a lot of fun! I might give it a try once. So what's up with you, is anything new in your daily routine?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L72: Calvin: Playing guitar in a rock band is awesome, Dave! It will bring you a lot of emotions.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L75: Dave: Sounds good, Calvin! Good company and great music, lift the mood and bring a lot of positive emotions! I have to go now. I'll see you soon!

/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-14.md:L24: Dave: Wow, Calvin! I bet playing for an eager audience was an incredible experience. Exploring Japan must have been amazing! How did Tokyo react to your music? Did you have any special moments there?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-14.md:L27: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! That show in Tokyo was awesome! Everyone was so into it when I played one of my songs and sang along. It was a magical moment.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-26.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Long time no talk! I had a great time yesterday, and visited some sights in Boston with a high school friend. It was really fun and eye-opening.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-03.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Long time no see. I just went to an awesome music thingy in Tokyo - so cool!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-03.md:L15: Dave: Hey Calvin! Great to hear from you. How was the music thingy in Tokyo? See any cool bands?

/memories/music-and-performance/session-03.md:L40: [Image caption: a photography of a city skyline with a boat in the water]

/memories/music-and-performance/session-03.md:L60: Dave: Definitely, Cal! Let's grab some food and I'll show you my favorite spots in the city. Can't wait to show them to you!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-06.md:L43: Calvin: Thanks Dave! Super excited for my upcoming performance in Tokyo this month. It's gonna be great to show my music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand my following!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-06.md:L46: Dave: Cool, Cal! Doing a show in Tokyo, wow! I'm sure the audience is gonna love it. Wishing you all the luck! Let me know how it goes.

/memories/music-and-performance/session-06.md:L57: Calvin: I took that pic in Tokyo last night. The skyline was stunning!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-06.md:L60: Dave: Wow, great shot! The night skyline really pops with those city lights. I gotta take a trip there soon!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-06.md:L63: Calvin: Thanks Dave! The city lights there are amazing. You should visit, it's awesome!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Been ages since we chatted. So much has gone down. Touring with Frank Ocean last week was wild. Tokyo was unreal -- the crowd was insane. I felt so alive when performing, can't find the words to express it.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L40: Dave: Yeah, Calvin! Accomplishment keeps me motivated. You mentioned Tokyo lit you up. Do you always enjoy performing live?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L58: Calvin: Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank! I'm buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like. Gonna be great playing for folks from home. What do you think of the music scene there?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L22: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I had the opportunity to meet Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and we clicked. We've been speaking and sharing ideas we arranged a meeting and recorded a song in the studio at my mansion - it's been great!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L25: Dave: Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L28: Calvin: It was an incredible experience, Dave! The city was buzzing with energy and the festival crowd was so lively - it was like fuel for my soul. Look at this photo, that's amazing!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L41: Calvin: Yeah Dave, someone even noticed my performance and now we're working together, which is wild. My tour ends soon and I'm heading to Boston. Maybe we can meet up then!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-16.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin! Long time no chat! How was the end of your tour? I bet it was amazing!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-16.md:L16: Calvin: Hey Dave! The tour was amazing! I was so pumped from all the energy from the audience. This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L30: Calvin: Thanks Dave! Lots of cool stuff happening. Next up, a tour - so excited! After that, I'm off to explore and grow my brand. Can't wait to see what the future has in store!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L33: Dave: Wow, Calvin! Congrats on the upcoming tour! Can't wait to see you perform. Do you have any cities or venues in mind?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L39: Dave: That sounds awesome, Calvin! Live music is the best. I'm sure you're gonna have a blast on tour and make some awesome memories. If you ever want to check out my garage and see some cool cars, I'd love to show you around. Keep rockin'!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L45: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Appreciate the kind words and support. Can't wait for your visit! Take care and keep creating amazing music! Check out pic of my garage, it looks stunning!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L49: Calvin: Thanks! I can't wait for your visit either. Take care and keep enjoying your hobbies!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Been a few days since we talked, but lots happened. Started touring with Frank Ocean and it's been amazing - so much energy from the crowd, such a connection when I'm on stage - unreal! Take a look at how I performed on stage, that was awesome!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L16: Dave: Congrats, Calvin! That's awesome. Being able to play your music to a crowd and feel that connection must be unreal. How's the tour going?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L19: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! The tour has been great, the energy from the crowd is awesome and jamming with Frank Ocean is a dream come true. It's been amazing!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L46: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! That pic was taken in Tokyo during a concert. Man, the energy was nuts - felt like the whole city came out!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L49: Dave: Wow, Calvin, Tokyo looks incredible! Here's a pic I found online, and it's making me dream about visiting someday. The energy there seems unbeatable! Have you ever visited streets like that?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L53: Calvin: Yes, Dave! That was an incredible experience to visit similar streets like you shared in your photo. Is there anything else that interests you in Tokyo?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L56: Dave: Of course, Calvin! Tokyo is amazing! I want to know everything about it - the people, the culture, the food, take a walk at the vibrant city life! In the photo below, the city is so alive and colorful that's impressive! It will be an unforgettable experience!
